hardware.requirements: One direct 200 Gb/s cable between the two Sparks; both Socket Direct functions carry the RoCEnante one-shot all-reduce. Unified memory per rank holds 81 GiB of weights, the encoders, compiled graphs, the KV reservation and host processes.

model.quantization: fp8 attention and dense projections, MXFP4 routed experts (checkpoint fp8 quantization config with mxfp4 store dtype), bf16 DFlash draft
model.identity_note: MiMo-V2.6-Flash-RL (MIT): 48 layers, 9 global-attention layers with 4 KV heads and 39 sliding-window layers with 8 KV heads and a 128-token window; Q/K head 192, V head 128; bundled five-layer DFlash draft (block size 8); vision and audio encoders. The pinned revision's dflash/config.json is valid JSON; earlier revisions need the launcher's corrected copy.

runtime.entrypoint: Pinned B12X/vLLM Python packages baked into a derived image; vLLM CLI through a login shell for CUDA compatibility initialization

serving.attention_backend: B12X for global and sliding-window target attention; packed Q/K-192, V-128 pages

cudagraph.note: C8 with five speculative tokens uses 48 query rows; the capture ceiling is 64. C16 admission can exceed that full-graph ceiling.

collectives.all_reduce: B12X RoCEnante one-shot up to 2 MiB over both Socket Direct functions (VLLM_ENABLE_ROCE_ALLREDUCE=1, B12X_ROCE_HCA one device per PCIe domain); PyNCCL above

serving.sizing_note: 12 GiB KV per rank is retained as a starting reservation. BF16 draft KV and the 64-row graph ceiling need TP2 memory qualification; historical Triton capacity does not apply.

evidence.conditions: Configuration adaptation from the measured TP4 B12X image; no TP2 hardware run for these settings.
evidence.result: Unmeasured. The historical Triton TP2 record does not qualify this image or its memory use.
evidence.conclusion: TP2 startup, memory, correctness and performance remain unqualified.
limitations: The image is built locally from pinned Python sources over a published native runtime; no prebuilt artifact is published.
TP2 has not been tested with B12X attention, BF16 draft KV or the 64-row capture ceiling.
No soak, accuracy suite, SparkCache composition or independent reproduction.

provenance.transport_implementation: B12X RoCEnante one-shot all-reduce with PyNCCL fallback
